_comment: Canonical Memory document shape. The g8e-compatible ensemble is the authority - it creates and owns this document. Memories are governed collection entries that persist agent-learned context across conversations. A field mismatch breaks memory recall and cross-conversation context building.
_consumers: client (reads to render memory management UI)

memory._description: A persistent memory entry created by the agent to retain learned context across conversations. Memories are scoped to a user or investigation and recalled during context building. Governed collection - mutations must go through POST /api/v1/governance/envelopes.

id.description: Unique memory identifier (UUID v4). Generated server-side by the agent.

content.description: The memory content text. What the agent learned and wants to recall.

user_id.description: User ID this memory belongs to. Memories are scoped per-user.

investigation_id.description: Investigation ID where this memory was created. Null for cross-investigation memories.

case_id.description: Case ID associated with this memory, if applicable.

scope.description: Memory scope - how widely the memory is recalled. See status.json memory.scope.

importance.description: Importance score (1-10). Higher values are prioritized during context building.

status.description: Memory lifecycle status. See status.json memory.status.

last_recalled_at.description: When this memory was last recalled during context building.
